introHtml: Custom 9 oz wine glasses are a smart choice for wine tastings, corporate events, and promotional giveaways where portion control and elegance matter. Unlike larger stemware, the 9 oz size keeps servings modest and reduces the risk of spills, making them ideal for outdoor receptions or trade show samplings. These glasses can be screen printed or etched with your logo for a sophisticated brand impression that stands out on any table.
